_note: Ready-made distinctive visual identities. Pick ONE per story (or derive a new one), set its tokens in :root, and commit. Each is a starting point — tune the accent to the subject.

editorial_dark.feel: Premium data-journalism, cinematic. Good default for serious/analytical stories.
editorial_dark.type: serif display + serif body + system-ui UI

newsprint_light.feel: Classic broadsheet: warm off-white paper, black ink, one ink-accent. Authoritative, text-forward.

neon_brutalist.feel: Bold, high-energy, chunky type and hard edges; for sport, music, culture, youth subjects.
neon_brutalist.type: heavy grotesk display + clean sans body

warm_magazine.feel: Lifestyle/feature warmth: soft surfaces, generous imagery, rounded cards; for food, travel, people.
warm_magazine.type: elegant serif display + humanist sans body (typography.json field_report)

swiss_international.feel: International-typographic: white field, strict grid, neo-grotesque, one hot accent. For structured, quantitative subjects.
swiss_international.type: neo-grotesque system-ui display + body, radius 0 (typography.json modern_desk)
swiss_international.subject: structured / quant rankings, comparisons, indices

data_zine.feel: Loud independent-zine energy: near-black field, thick rules, oversized grotesk, mono captions. For youth, culture, music.
data_zine.type: heavy grotesk display + mono captions, thick rules (typography.json modern_desk display + mono)
data_zine.subject: youth / culture / music

annual_report.feel: Corporate-report restraint: warm paper, navy ink, transitional serif headings over humanist sans body. For finance and org metrics.
annual_report.type: transitional serif display + humanist sans body (typography.json broadsheet display + modern_desk body)
annual_report.subject: finance / org metrics

retro_print.feel: Vintage print: aged paper, antique slab headings, old-style serif body, paper grain. For history and year-in-review.
retro_print.type: antique slab display + old-style serif body + paper grain (typography.json field_report; finish.json paper_grain)
retro_print.subject: history / year-in-review

terminal_mono.feel: Green-on-black terminal: monospace everything, scanline-flat surfaces, phosphor accent. For software and leaderboards.
terminal_mono.type: monospace display + body (typography.json tier2_websafe mono; or modern_desk mono)
terminal_mono.subject: software / benchmarks / leaderboards

luxury_serif.feel: Premium editorial: deep warm-black field, gold accent, didone headlines over a transitional serif body. For premium profiles and design.
luxury_serif.type: didone display + transitional serif body (typography.json didone_fashion)
luxury_serif.subject: premium profiles / design

_typography_link: Each theme's `type` direction names a pairing in typography.json — wire that pairing's stacks into :root (--font-display / --font-body / --font-ui|--font-mono). Defaults: warm_magazine -> field_report, newsprint_light -> broadsheet, editorial_dark -> didone_fashion (or luxury_serif), swiss_international -> modern_desk, terminal_mono -> tier2_websafe mono. Record the chosen pairing name in designer.json page_rhythm.
choosing: Match the theme to the subject and tone; pick the accent from the data's meaning. Record the chosen theme + accent in designer.json page_rhythm so the Programmer applies it consistently.
anti_patterns: Generic-AI look: bootstrap blue, a purple/indigo gradient hero, everything center-aligned, one default system font, evenly-spaced soulless cards.
Default chart colors (raw Vega/D3 palettes) instead of the story's tokens.
A 'tone card' audio widget bolted on with no link to the data.
Decorative stock-style images that say nothing; or AI images for concrete real subjects where a real photo exists.
Walls of equal-weight charts with no hierarchy, captions or annotation.
Hero with no clear focal point or a headline competing with a busy background (always use a scrim).
make_it_distinctive: Commit to one bold idea (a signature color, a recurring motif, an unusual but readable type pairing).
Give the page a clear focal centerpiece (the map, the lead interactive, a hero stat).
Use real-world texture (photos, embeds, maps) so it feels reported, not synthesized.
Vary rhythm and centerpiece between stories so outputs don't look templated.
